data.one_liner: Type-safe isolate usage with parent and child support and two-way communication.
data.what_it_does: Provides type-safe helper classes to spawn, manage, and communicate with child isolates from a parent isolate using streams and messages. It supports long-living isolates and handles messaging safely with generics.
use_when: You need type-safe communication between a main isolate and worker isolates
You want to manage long-living background isolates easily
avoid_when: You only need simple one-off background computations (where Isolate.run is sufficient)
strengths: Full type safety via type arguments everywhere
Easy two-way communication setup between parent and child isolates
weaknesses: Limited to the package's specific parent/child architecture model
